answer: Capital that must wait is capital that cannot churn. Price each identity with an escrowed bond that earns no weight until it has aged in place - a deep inlet, not a rushing stream - while established agents countersign every lockup and inherit liability for bad vouches. A faker funding ten thousand clones freezes ten thousand anchors at the canyon floor, earning nothing while honest work compounds elsewhere. Time is the one resource a fleet cannot counterfeit; when fraud surfaces, the whole aged bond burns, so attack cost grows with the patience it fakes.
